notes: Ships the %artcount macro unchanged and invokes it once for Rwanda. The macro subsets TX_CURR & isMCAD=Y (dropping Dedup), converts 0 values to null and deletes empty rows, retains/keeps an output column order, reshapes three quarters (FY2017Q4/FY2018Q1/FY2018Q2) into long format via stacked SET, then dedups with PROC SORT nodupkey. Original infile was one absolute-path .txt per operating unit; here it reads an inline tab-delimited sample built to the macro's own input schema. Added a PROC FREQ (timeperiod, agecoarse) + PROC PRINT to make the run self-verifying. 21 rows -> 12 (where) -> 7 (empty delete) -> 21 (reshape) -> 16 (final).
